label: 7.0 cm Inner Edge Fold (Slanted)
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Photograph of a black/charcoal trouser leg opening shot from the INSIDE - the woven brand label reading '...elberts' appears mirrored at the top edge. Brightened, the construction reads clearly: the hem allowance is turned up and machine-topstitched with a visible folded lower edge, and the inseam/outseam allowances are overlocked (serged) in a lighter thread. So it is a plain inner-fold hem with no turn-up or cuff, which is the right family for this option. However nothing in frame provides scale, so the 7.0 cm fold depth cannot be checked, and the diagonal of the hemline is just the angle the garment is lying at, not evidence of a slanted hem.
